race.title: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series At Punchestown Festival 2027 Qualifier Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS showed improved form when winning last season and returns from a summer break still relatively unexposed. The longer trip should play to his strengths and he's taken to make a winning return. Tangara Bay is on the comeback trail but represents a yard in red-hot form and is feared most after just a handful of starts, while both Jacovec Cavern and Sonny May are respected. THANKYOUFORTHEDAYS (IRE) TANGARA BAY (FR) JACOVEC CAVERN
